messages:
newhire-olivia: Hey everyone — Olivia here, started today on Platform. Quick org question: who owns VPN/VPC access vs dedicated inference infra? Also who should I ping for high-priority production network or quota incidents?
alyssa-peopleops: Welcome Olivia! :tada: For access provisioning we hand off to eng-platform (see onboarding checklist I DM'd). For anything org/perm related ping me.
newhire-olivia: Thanks! Is there a simple map of ownerships (e.g., console, hosted-api, dedicated infra, infra-oncall)? Trying to know who to @ in a crisis.
mike-eng-platform: @newhire-olivia +1. Platform owns onboarding flows, VPN/VPC templates, and Dedicated infra day-to-day. We also own IAM roles used by the Private deploys.
sara-eng-sre: Eng-SRE owns oncall for production incidents (latency spikes, region failovers, automated fallbacks). If it's a config or capacity problem in Dedicated, start with eng-platform, then escalate to eng-sre if customer impact > P2.
james-product: For feature/product ownership: Product owns API behavior/contract; Eng Platform owns infra that serves it. If you see inference regressions that look model-related, tag @research and @eng-ml as well.
mike-eng-platform: Here's a tiny cheat-sheet we use in ops channels:
```
Ownership cheat-sheet:
- Hosted API incidents: eng-sre -> eng-platform -> eng-ml (if model)
- Dedicated infra (capacity/config): eng-platform -> eng-sre (prod impact)
- Private/VPC onboarding: eng-platform + security ops -> support for docs
- Billing/usage/quota: finance-sdks -> eng-platform for throttles
```
newhire-olivia: This is super helpful. Any escalation contact info? (pager, slack, severity rules)
sara-eng-sre: Pager rotation is in the ops handbook (linked in #eng-sre). Quick rules: P1 = customer outage (page eng-sre & oncall), P2 = degraded but still serving (slack + email to eng-platform), P3 = ticket/async. If you're unsure, page — better safe.
alyssa-peopleops: Also note: for first-week entitlements we auto-approve key bits but networking needs a ticket to eng-platform for subnet/VPC peering. Use the "Onboarding: infra access" template in Jira.
newhire-olivia: Great, I'll file the ticket now. Thanks everyone! cc @mike-eng-platform @sara-eng-sre
onboard-bot: Reminder: Olivia, complete Security Basics and MFA setup within 48 hours to avoid access delays.
mike-eng-platform: ping me if the VPN certs don't land. I can nudge infra team.
newhire-olivia: Will do — appreciate the quick answers. :)
